messages:
jordan (customer-success): heads-up — HelioHealth says Org Admins suddenly can't access the console or deploy models after last night's role refactor. billing page 403, models endpoints returning permission denied. ticket HH-842.
reza (support): ugh. can you paste the tenant/org id and any error text they see? also any recent role-change audit ids?
heliohealth-admin: tenant org_helio_01. screenshot shows: 
`403 Forbidden: user missing permission models.list`
and when trying billing: `AccessDenied: insufficient_scope`
jordan (customer-success): they also pasted an audit snippet: 
```
audit.log: time=2026-03-19T02:11:03Z event=role_mapping_update actor=svc-role-migrate target=helio-org-admins diff=-binding(org_admin)
```
ming (eng-security): thanks — initial hypothesis: the role refactor job removed the group->role binding for helio-org-admins (roleshadowing/merge bug). could also be an unintended KMS grant change if model keys are per-org. ops-bot, can you surface the rolesync run from last night?
ops-bot: rolesync-run-2026-03-19: status=success elapsed=00:12:14 applied=4031 removed=1 errors=0 job_id=rs-20260319-04
ops-bot: diff excerpt: `- binding: group: helio-org-admins -> role: org_admin`
reza (support): ok that's consistent. ming, can we do a quick restore of that binding while we investigate root cause? need approval from CS to act on customer org.
jordan (customer-success): HelioHealth gave us go-ahead to reapply bindings for org_helio_01. please keep them informed.
ming (eng-security): remediation plan: 1) re-add the binding for helio-org-admins -> org_admin 2) re-run rolesync in dry-run to confirm no other removals 3) check KMS grants for model keys referencing org_helio_01 and ensure key grants weren't altered. ops, can you run the apply?
ops-bot: running command: `rbac-cli apply --org org_helio_01 --patch '{"bindings": [{"group":"helio-org-admins","role":"org_admin"}]}'`
ops-bot: apply result: success, bindings_added=1 job=rbac-apply-1995012501
heliohealth-admin: trying console again... now I can see org settings and billing — :tada: models deploy works too. Thanks.
reza (support): great. marking incident as customer-facing resolved. please hold while we confirm there are no lingering permission gaps (models, embeddings, billing, KMS access).
ming (eng-security): quick follow-ups: - record the exact rolesync diff and investigate why svcs-role-migrate removed that binding (is it mapping rule? was a merge strategy bug?) - rotate any temporary KMS grants we used during remediation - schedule a postmortem with eng-infra and devex - add a guard in rolesync to prevent bulk-removal of org_admin bindings without explicit confirmation
jordan (customer-success): I'll notify HelioHealth that access is restored and we plan a postmortem.
ops-bot: post-remediation check: `rbac-cli audit --org org_helio_01 | grep org_admin` shows expected bindings present.
ming (eng-security): assigning action items: ming -> debug rolesync mapping rules, ops -> add safety check in rolesync deploy, jordan -> customer comms, reza -> close ticket after PM scheduled.
heliohealth-admin: confirmed billing invoices visible, models list works, and team can deploy. thanks for fast turnaround. :heart:
jordan (customer-success): closing loop in HH-842 with timeline and action items. we'll follow up with scheduled postmortem in 48 hours.
reza (support): closing slack thread; reopening if anything else pops up. :thumbsup:
